newsitem.title: FRANCE: Valeo to establish plant in Ohio.
newsitem.headline: Valeo to establish plant in Ohio.

text.p: French car components manufacturer Valeo said on Tuesday that it would invest around 100 million francs to establish a new cooling systems plant in Hamilton, Ohio, to serve North American clients.
It said in a statement that it had acquired the site and expected the plant to be running in the springtime. It said it expected to employ around 300 people there in 1998.
The site will complement production at Valeo's Greensburg, Indiana, thermic systems plant "where new investments are also planned", it said.

Valeo has 10 production sites in North America -- Canada, Mexico and the United States -- where it employs 2,300 people and expects to generate 3.5 billion francs in sales this year, out of an estimated 28.5 billion worldwide.
